        cand=planner.optimal_response(prob,primal,d)
        errs=checker.check(line,cand["response"])
    elif res is not None and res.status==2:
        cert=planner.witness_phase_one(prob)
        errs=checker.check(line,planner.infeasible_response(req,cert)) if cert else ["phase1 none"]
    else:
        errs=[]
    dt=time.perf_counter()-t0; tot+=dt; n+=1
    if errS if False else errs: slow.append((dt,i,errs))
    if dt>1.0: print("slow line %d %.2fs"%(i,dt))
